about.title: About Us
about.body: ISL — the F1 Israeli Super League — is one of the biggest sim racing leagues in the country, formed when two of Israel's most experienced F1 sim racing leagues merged into one. Racing primarily on the EA Sports F1 series and currently in its {season}, ISL is built by drivers, for drivers: a strong, supportive community, highly competitive grids, and a deep commitment to clean, respectful racing—both on and off the track. With structured seasons, consistent stewarding, and a culture that values fairness and sportsmanship, ISL sets the highest standard for organized sim racing in Israel.
